include.description:
Include spec representing the minimum desired set of fields to be present in the returned instance.  By default,
if the instance was already fetched with an include that fully contains this include, the input instance is
simply returned.  Otherwise, the requested include is used to fetch a new instance and that instance is returned.

ignoreIfMissing.description:
By default, if the input instance contains an id and we need to perform a fetch to get the missing data, if the
instance does not exist in the database, an error is thrown.
If True, the input instance will be returned with the `meta.referenceInvalid` flag set to true.

failIfIdMissing.description:
If true and the input instance doesn't contain an id and we need to perform a fetch to get the missing data, an
error is thrown.  Otherwise, the input instance will be returned with the `meta.referenceInvalid` flag set to true.

mergeResult.description:
If true and we need to perform a fetch to get the missing data, the newly fetched instance will be fetched with
the requested include merged with the input's `meta.fetchInclude`.  Otherwise only the requested include will be
used.

resolveRefTypes.description:
By default, entity references retrieved via {@link Persistable#fetch} and {@link Persistable#get} only include the
`id` of the reference, unless additional fields in the referenced type are added as part of the include spec.
Also, for references to extended/parametric types, the returned instances will have the type of the the field's
reference type, rather than the concrete type of the actual instances themselves.

If this flag is set to true, then those instances will be of the correct concrete type if they aren't already.
Note that this requires additional queries/joins (up to 1 for each referenced field) so it should only be used when
having the instances of the concrete type is necessary.
